edge_type_semantics.approves: A completed review authorizes construction of the dependent approval object.
edge_type_semantics.binds: The dependent immutable authority records the exact identity of the prerequisite.
edge_type_semantics.generated_from: The dependent generated artifact is deterministically derived from the prerequisite bytes or identities.
edge_type_semantics.hashes: The dependent object contains the exact digest of the prerequisite object.
edge_type_semantics.requires: The dependent object cannot be constructed or accepted without the prerequisite.
edge_type_semantics.reviews: The dependent review evaluates the exact complete prerequisite object.
edge_type_semantics.targets: The dependent review target identifies the exact immutable prerequisite object.
